angle: A high-risk, high-reward 29.7m pass by Daan Hendriks that carried real chance value into the final third for Kwabena Asante.

explanation.why_it_matters: Hendriks’ 29.7m, difficulty 73 pass (success_prob 0.273) delivered xt_added 0.0802 into the left final third, choosing reward over safety and creating a genuine attacking chance. Coming after a chaos spike to 65 while chaos is 32 and home control_share 0.7, it was a deliberate attempt to disrupt Northbridge’s control (dva -0.093).
